## 7. AI Workflows & Tactics
- Date: Undated in supplied material  
  Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xJQuF02NAK8  
  Summary: The highest-signal workflow is an “Explore → Plan → Code → Commit” loop for Claude Code. The tactic is to first let the model inspect the repo and gather constraints, then require an explicit implementation plan, then execute changes, then review or commit only after verification.  
  Why it matters: This is a practical guardrail against premature code edits and reduces failure modes from insufficient context.

- Date: Undated in supplied material  
  Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bcM9dP_uXJU  
  Summary: The tutorial frames agentic work as goal-directed execution rather than chat: define the desired outcome, let Claude break it into phases, require clarification before execution, and keep work inside a managed project workspace.  
  Setup: Open Claude desktop/code workspace, create a project folder, provide the goal and constraints, require a plan before edits, then have the agent execute and self-review.  
  Availability: Available now, per supplied transcript.  
  Why it matters: The operational insight is not a new model release; it is a repeatable pattern for turning one-off prompting into structured automation.
